title: Customer latency-sensitivity synthesis and fallback pricing thresholds
creator: Sofia Ruiz
description: Goal: produce an evidence-backed synthesis that ties enterprise buyer latency tolerance curves to model fallback / pricing thresholds and procurement triggers. Problem: Sales and Solutions teams are making ad-hoc fallback decisions when a model variant is unavailable, causing hidden latency spikes or unexpected cost increases for customers. Outcome: a recommended decision rubric + two playbooks (SMB / Enterprise) and a simple readiness index teams can use during sales/provisioning and when configuring Redwood routing policies.
deliverables: Latency-sensitivity synthesis report (executive + appendix with raw interview notes)
Model fallback pricing thresholds (recommended numeric ranges by buyer cohort)
Model Supply Readiness Index (MSRI) — 5-factor scorecard and calculator
Two playbooks: SMB fallback defaults; Enterprise procurement & negotiation checklist
Notebooks with scoring logic + example routing policy JSON snippets for Console
acceptance_criteria: Interviewed at least 12 customers across SMB and Enterprise segments (notes uploaded)
MSRI prototype validated against 3 historical outages/fallback events showing expected customer impact
Pricing threshold recommendations reviewed and approved by Revenue Ops and Solutions Engineering
Playbooks prototyped in Console as sample routing policies and sanity-tested in staging
